what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from India in Austria: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 219 Indian asylum seekers in Austria, 0.1% of all asylum seekers from India.
Refugees from India, a separate group, live mostly in Canada, the United States, Portugal and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kashmir territory in India and over the government of India in every year from 2001 to 2025.
The fact pack does not link these conflicts to the asylum figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2006 at 1429 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 7646, at the end of 2022, the main year of displacement in the data, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Austria.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Austria only.
